securityAssessment: read-heavy-01: Find cross-tenant data exposure in the account-summary request path

tenantIsolationFindings.statement: The process-wide cache is keyed only by accountId, allowing identical account IDs in different tenants to share a summary.
The tenant identifier is also omitted on cache insertion, confirming the lookup/write key mismatch.

sourceLocations.excerpt: if (Cache.TryGetValue(accountId, out var hit)) return hit;

correctlyScopedCode: AccountStore correctly filters by both tenant and account; the leak is introduced above it.
